race.description: Bet365 Same Race Multi Mdn Plate
race.comment: The first of a couple of famed Manangatang maidens and MISIL BEAUTY (7) looks the testing material in this one. Found the placings at Griffith two starts back before finishing fourth over 1900m at Leeton last time. Back in trip here but gets blinkers on and draws beautifully. MEET THE PRINCE (10) missed the placings two starts back when resuming then ran a better race and finished 1.75 lengths away in sixth last time out over 1400m at Coleraine. Has the ability to take care of this field. SHAYKHLISLAMOVA (9) got into the placings a couple back, albeit beaten a long way, then finished much closer last time up. Rises back in trip here, which might secure an even better result. SCARTAKA (12) hasn't placed in six runs to date, but has been around the mark and gets out to this trip for the first time in his career. LADY COLONIST (6) lost the rider last time out, but did start $3.40 off some performances that looks the right form for this.
